title: OccupancyCompanionV1 — worker occupancy claim bound to one FactCandidateV1 before fact2 exists
description: Worker occupancy product emitted on FactBatchV3 alongside unchanged FactCandidateV1, associated by candidateOrdinal in that batch. It is not TargetAttributionV2 or a frame of its own. It omits planId, sourceFactId and producerClosure; the host projects those fields from retained Plan/stage provenance and the corresponding minted fact.

candidateOrdinal.description: Must equal FactCandidateV1.candidateOrdinal of a candidate in THIS FactBatchV3. Transport association only. Never enters fact2 identity. uint64, not a narrowed 1e6 bound.

targetUniverseId.description: Exact byte-equal to the associated FactCandidateV1.targetUniverseId. Host projects V2.targetUniverse from the minted fact, never from a second host guess.

targetNativeId.description: Must equal the associated candidate's decoded relation payload field named by evaluator-projection-registry relations[relation].targetNativeIdField at that resolution. Opaque payload copy. Not occupancy identity for file/package.

logicalPath.description: Non-authoritative hint permitted only for kind=file or kind=symbol with external or unknown occupancy. Null for first-party occupancy, kind=package or kind=unknown.

candidateOrdinal.law: unique strictly increasing by candidateOrdinal (sorted unique integers). Gaps are lawful at this annotation.
candidateOrdinal.not: contiguous 0..n-1. Contiguous candidate-stream 0..n-1 across FactBatch frames of one requested stage is a separate host join against DispatchBindingV1.expectedFirstCandidateOrdinal and later batch continuation. The annotation does not encode that stream law.
candidateOrdinal.implementation: canonical.py exact_order token candidateOrdinal. Empty arrays admit. Reverse order refuses. Duplicate candidateOrdinal refuses. Non-integer candidateOrdinal refuses.
candidateOrdinal.semanticJoin: Each occupancyCompanions[i].candidateOrdinal MUST name a candidates[j].candidateOrdinal in THIS batch (PROVIDER_RETURN_UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE otherwise). Association is before fact2 exists.

x-opensip-wire.historicalFactCandidateV1: unchanged; additionalProperties false; no occupancy field
x-opensip-wire.historicalFactBatchV2: unchanged closed payload when the token is not negotiated
x-opensip-wire.notAFrame: OccupancyCompanionV1 is not itself a protocol3 frame. FactBatch remains the ANALYZING worker-to-host frame.
x-opensip-wire.protocolMajor: rust-semantic remains 3; typescript-semantic remains 2; payload version of FactBatch is capability-gated, not a silent field add under FactBatchV2
x-opensip-wire.stageId: FactBatchV3.stageId is C-2 TEXT of the current requested stage, not this companion's field
